C1075.title: Two Sentenced for Installing Covert Camera Equipment in Hotels to Film Guests
C1075.summary: Since March 2021, defendants Yan Mouping and Yan Moujian purchased specialized covert camera equipment from e-commerce platforms and installed it in multiple rooms across three hotels to secretly film others' private activities.
